greeting.client: Hi, I'm Jose's assistant. Tell me what you need for your website or app and I'll point you the right way: timing, how he works and where to start.
greeting.partner: Hi, I'm Jose's assistant. If you're an agency or consultancy, I can tell you how Jose fits into your projects: white label, hourly or per feature.
greeting.recruiter: Hi, I'm Jose's assistant. Ask about his experience, his stack or his availability and I'll answer with what he has published.
greeting.curious: Hi, I'm Jose's assistant. Ask anything about his work, his projects or how he does it.
